**Preferred gene-related syndrome label**
GPR161-related medulloblastoma predisposition

**Synonyms**

**Parent term (use [OLS](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols/ontologies/mondo), or your favorite ontology browser)**

**Definition**
A predisposition to medulloblastoma, a tumor that originates in the cerebellum and dorsal brainstem, has a peak incidence in childhood, and makes up a large proportion of embryonal brain tumors.
